description: Produce a standard-library Python module that produces boundary values for an integer range, plus pytest tests. Choose this when you need the boundary and just-outside values of an inclusive integer range, with tests. Do not choose this for non-integer ranges, random data generation, or property-based testing frameworks. Example requests: Write a Python module that produces the boundary and just-outside values for an integer range, with tests. | I need boundary values for an inclusive integer range for test data. | Generate a boundary-value module and prove it with pytest.
